title: Settlement Confirmation
description: A second, independently signed trust artifact (M4b) closing a connector-mediated action's lifecycle (e.g. a Razorpay refund) once its externally-reported outcome has been independently fetch-verified against the connector's own API — never inferred from an inbound webhook claim alone. Append-only: creating one never mutates the original Receipt, the Trust Record's own trustRecordHash/signature, or any other artifact.

businessTransactionId.description: Business Transaction this confirmation closes the lifecycle for.

receiptId.description: The Receipt this confirmation references, when one existed on the Trust Record at confirmation time. Absent when no Receipt had been generated yet.

webhookEventId.description: The webhook event id (X-Razorpay-Event-Id) that triggered processing. The webhook is only ever a doorbell: this records what prompted the fetch-verify, not evidence of the outcome.

razorpayRefundId.description: The Razorpay refund id this confirmation is about.

status.description: SETTLED when the fetched refund status was "processed"; SETTLEMENT_FAILED otherwise. Derived exclusively from fetchedRefundStatus, never from the webhook's own claimed event type.

fetchedRefundStatus.description: The refund's status exactly as fetched from Razorpay's API at confirmation time — the authoritative state this confirmation records.

signature.description: Digital signature over the Settlement Confirmation.
